name: autogen

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key. AutoGen defaults to OpenAI-compatible chat completions.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for Claude-backed agents.

AUTOGEN_CONFIG.description: Path to a JSON file describing the agent group (roles, tools, termination). Defaults to ./autogen.config.json.

WORK_DIR.description: Working directory for code-execution agents. Defaults to ./.autogen-work.

notes: Multi-agent group chat orchestrator from Microsoft. MONITOR tier — group chats can spin up code-execution agents that write to WORK_DIR, so every turn is observed. Higher trust floor than single-agent coders because the failure mode (runaway loops, recursive tool calls) is less bounded.
